item.name: Get adoption rates for an app channel.

request.name: Get adoption rates for an app channel.

description.content:
Returns a report of version adoption rates for a channel, grouped by day or week, and filtered by license type and date range.
The report helps track how quickly customers are upgrading to new releases.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/channel/[:channelid]/read

query.description: (Required) Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
(Required) Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format
Interval to group the report by. Valid values are "1d" and "1w".  Default is 1d

Return a .tgz file containing the embedded cluster release for the specified channel and app.
Optional query parameters allow specifying a channel sequence, a customer license file to include, and whether to include an airgap bundle.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/channel/[:channelid]/embeddedcluster/release

query.description: If provided, downloads the embedded cluster release for the given channel sequence.
If provided, includes the customer's license file in the embedded cluster release.
If provided, includes the airgap bundle in the embedded cluster release.

If provided, only the specified components are included in the release.
Comma-separated list of component names: binary, release, license, ec-online-bundle, app-airgap-bundle, ec-airgap-bundle.
When omitted, all components are included.
